source_audit: 35 photographs, visually inspected and measured; see the Phase 2C audit.

selection_contract.customer_photo_wins: A customer-supplied Image URL or upload disables stock selection entirely.
selection_contract.industry_match: HARD GATE. A photo is eligible only when the brief resolves to one of the slugs in its industries[]. No nearest-neighbour fallback.
selection_contract.orientation_rule: A portrait product may use only portrait photos; a landscape product only landscape photos; a near-square product may use either.
selection_contract.text_safety: Important text must not sit on a region graded poor unless overlay_guidance.scrim_opacity_if_used is applied.
selection_contract.suppresses: When a photo is placed, design-asset usage drops to at most one quiet texture or frame.
